propositions: rebar init silently creates an empty divergent orphan branch when the configured tickets remote fetch fails or times out, instead of failing closed

the current tri-state logic (local ref exists, local remote-tracking ref exists, or create orphan) cannot distinguish a reachable remote that advertises the branch from an unreachable remote, causing false positives on first init

multiple code paths (_mount_or_create_branch, pending_init_attaches_to_existing, ensure_store_mounted_best_effort, _create_tracker) must share a single bounded remote-branch existence probe with cached tri-state results to avoid duplicate timeouts and ensure consistent behavior
ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable remotes as do-not-auto-mount without raising, allowing a strict downstream path to reuse the cached result and report the actionable failure
the new --force-new-store flag must permit deliberate orphan bootstrap only when reachability is unknown, and warn or have no effect when the remote is reachable
